original.target_description: Janssen et al. (2010) supporting material: earnings/resource harvesting and costly punishment with and without communication. The neutral description and p. S17 do not uniquely specify a treatment contrast, earnings definition, or period block; target correspondence remains unresolved.

n.sample_role: Unresolved target. Table S4A reports net group-earnings observations across three-period blocks; p. 23 reports punishment-event-frequency observations by period. Neither is a count of independent individual participants.
n.exclusions: Procedures report 175 students recruited and two groups dropped: one browser closure and one locked keyboard key. This recruitment count is not assigned as target analytic N.

notes:
Identity verified from supplied source: Supporting Online Material for Lab Experiments for the Study of Social-Ecological Systems; Marco A. Janssen, Robert Holahan, Allen Lee, Elinor Ostrom; Published 30 April 2010, Science 328, 613 (2010); DOI 10.1126/science.1183532. This is primary supporting material, not a secondary article or preregistration. Source contains methods, supporting analyses, and tables through S7. No PDF path supplied; no rendering or acquisition attempted. Only n_o and es_value_o are assigned; all other values are placeholders. Candidate evidence, not target assignments: p. 17 Table S4A gives within-treatment first-three versus last-three period net-earnings comparisons: NCP-C U=216 (15,15), p=0.000; NCP-P U=163 (15,15), p=0.037; NCP-CP U=317.5 (18,18), p=0.000; C-NCP U=141.5 (15,15), p=0.232; P-NCP U=221.5 (18,18), p=0.059; CP-NCP U=255 (18,18), p=0.003. The same page also contains Table S3C gross-earnings first/last-block comparisons. p. 18 Table S4B includes between-treatment net-earnings comparisons and p. 16 Table S3B their gross-earnings counterparts. p. 23 directly compares punishment-event distributions with versus without communication, U=710 (36,33), p=0.165. p. 26 additionally tests harvesting around punishment events, yielding multiple distinct U tests. The description does not resolve which of these outcomes/contrasts is intended. No candidate is promoted to a positive field. No analytic N sum is performed: candidate counts can involve repeated periods from the same groups; final mutually exclusive target groups are not uniquely established. Methods recruitment/exclusion evidence: In total, 175 students participated in the
experiments, but two groups of participants were dropped from the data analysis.
